summary: This release adds safe GitHub-based update checks while preserving the existing GTK 4 interface and Linux package workflow.
changelog: Added one automatic update check per application startup.
Added manual update checking to the About window.
Added distinct optional and mandatory update policies.
Added a compact update window with summary and expandable full changelog.
Kept startup fail-open when GitHub, the network, or the manifest is unavailable.
Added strict schema validation, semantic version comparison, HTTPS-only requests, size limits, and a short timeout.
Kept package installation under user and distribution control; the application never runs sudo, apt, or dpkg.
Centralized the application version in mail_exporter/__init__.py.
Added maintainer documentation and automated update-check tests.
